name: Karnataka Bank SBI Card PRIME

reward_terms_ktb.snapshot_note: Karnataka Bank's OWN 'banking-ekit' T&C booklet (51pp) -- same template shape as UCO/City Union Bank's own booklets, independently verified. Section 11/Welcome Gift/Priority Pass confirmed to state the SAME rates/caps/MCCs as base PRIME. Same documentation-structure difference as UCO/CUB: Sec 11.3(b) defers 'other exclusions' to the generic Shop-and-Smile page (confirmed there independently, see ewallet_reward_exclusion's own _note). Welcome Gift wording differs cosmetically from UCO/CUB's (this one uses base PRIME's own generic 'range of brand options via gyftr.com' phrasing rather than naming 'Aditya Birla Fashion Retail'), and ADDITIONALLY defines 'eligible year' explicitly ('the year in which the fee is paid for by the Cardholder') -- a clarifying detail base PRIME's own checklist flagged as an open question (item 3's second half), now resolved BY THIS CARD'S OWN TEXT (not applied retroactively to base PRIME/BOM/PSB/UCO/CUB, which don't state it).

version._note: MITC fee table page 8 (own image render confirmed, not the garbled multi-column text extraction), 'Karnataka Bank SBI Card PRIME' row: Annual Fee Rs.2,999, Renewal Fee Rs.2,999 (waived on annual spends of Rs.3 Lakh or more in the preceding year) -- IDENTICAL to base SBI Card PRIME's own row. thresholds._note: MITC fee table page 8, 'Karnataka Bank SBI Card PRIME' row: waived at Rs.3 Lakh annual spend -- identical to base PRIME. Same as UCO/CUB: no supplementary 'Spends Based Reversal' narrative in this card's own reward_terms -- MITC is the sole source here.

benefits._note: Priority Pass terms rate table: '4 visits* for SBI Card PRIME Cardholder per year', max 2/quarter -- confirmed identical to base PRIME in this card's own booklet.

Welcome Gift T&C: 'vouchers in multiples of Rs.1000, up to a total value of Rs.3000... via gyftr.com/rewards/sbiwelcomekit', gated on fee payment for 'the eligible year' -- THIS card's own text additionally defines 'eligible year' explicitly as 'the year in which the fee is paid for by the Cardholder' (e.g. card opened 1 June 2012 -> eligible year = 1 June 2012 to 31 May 2013), resolving base PRIME's own open sub-question for THIS card specifically (not retroactively applied to the others). Same value/gating as base PRIME -- same engine gap (fee-gated, not spend-gated, no Threshold can grant it).
